claim_boundary: This is an oracle-assisted encoding control after Q1493 search runs, not unpinned solve cost or natural yield. If it fails, downgrade interpretation of Q1493 search timeouts to an unresolved rotated-CNF wiring question.
method: Use Q1493 frozen rotated CNF builder at N53 rotation 44, including its first-window-zero unit clause. Append 327 additional Q1490 witness pins for four rotated raw leaf x values, two rotated pair-midpoint x values and rotated target-preimage index 141. Run the frozen Q1482 native solver and independently verify the model against the rotated CNF and inverse-Frobenius public target.
success_gate: SAT model satisfies the Q1493 first-window rotated CNF plus all witness pins and independently transports a four-distinct-column relation back to the original ordinary N53 public target.
